name: Maderuelo (Spain)
description: Square flag quartered red and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Maderuelo (a castle wall on red, and a crescent on red).
history: The arms and flag of Maderuelo were published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 19 February 1997; the flag is square, of proportion 1:1, quartered of red and white, with the municipal arms in its colours over all at the centre.
